pages.title: Cozy Puzzle: Cats
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description:
Cozy Puzzle: Cats turns cats into pieces of a shape-fitting puzzle. Drag them from the bottom of the screen onto the board, rotating a piece with a click when its outline needs a different orientation. Every piece must fit inside the border, with no overlapping cats or empty cells left behind.

Complete the arrangement to finish a level and earn stars, with fewer unnecessary moves improving the result. The campaign introduces more cats for your collection, while random puzzles and daily or weekly challenges provide other boards to solve. Check the shape of the remaining gaps before committing a cat to its place.

pages.title: 2048 Snake.io
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description:
2048 Snake.io combines a growing chain with numbered-cube merging. Guide your chain around the arena, gather cubes and bring matching values together to increase your score. Other chains share the space, so choosing a route involves avoiding dangerous collisions as well as finding useful numbers.

Hold and drag with a mouse or finger to steer. Look ahead for cubes that can merge with the numbers you already have, then adjust your direction as rivals move across the arena. Successful merges develop the chain and contribute to the final score.

pages.title: Burger Day
pages.creator: TTWebGames
pages.description:
Burger Day puts you behind the counter of a burger kitchen, assembling orders for waiting customers. Click or tap ingredients to stack each burger according to the request, then complete the order before the ticking clock puts more pressure on the kitchen.

Customer requests become more demanding as you progress through the levels. Read the required ingredients before choosing them so that a quick decision still produces the right burger. Serving the current customers moves you toward the next kitchen challenge.

pages.title: Sneaker Factory!
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description:
Sneaker Factory! combines factory management with driving deliveries. Organize sneakers, complete customer orders and send shipments out, building the reputation that determines your level. Sorting, fulfilling orders and constructing improvements all contribute to that progress.

Use the management buttons to run the factory. During a delivery, the Right arrow accelerates, the Left arrow brakes or reverses, and Space makes the delivery vehicle jump. The touch version provides corresponding arrow buttons. Moving between factory work and cargo runs gives you several ways to earn reputation, so keep the orders and shipments moving as the business develops.

pages.title: Bank Boom Tung Tung Sahur
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description:
Bank Boom Tung Tung Sahur makes opening a bank vault a contest between two rivals. Reach the vault and stay on it for twenty seconds to open it first. You can also swing a club at your opponent to slow their attempt, adding interference to the race for the safe.

Use WASD or the arrow keys to move, with S or the Down arrow swinging the club. Watch your rival's position while working toward the vault: an opening to interrupt them may help you regain the lead, but you still need to secure the safe yourself.

pages.title: Single Stroke: Energy Line Puzzle
pages.creator: Ropoto
pages.description:
Single Stroke: Energy Line Puzzle asks you to light every circle with one connected drawing. Trace a continuous line through the arrangement, considering the whole route before making the next part of the stroke.

A hint is available when you need help finding a way through, and restarting lets you approach the same level again. Look at how the circles are positioned relative to each other and plan a route that reaches them all as one continuous path.

pages.title: Doodle Football
pages.creator: Tejas Shrimali
pages.description:
Doodle Football is a drawing puzzle in which your lines help a football reach the goal. Hold the left mouse button and draw a route suited to the obstacles, then press the Start button or Space to set the attempt in motion.

Courses use grassy, desert and icy settings, with each arrangement giving you a different path to work out. If the ball does not reach the goal, use Restart or R and revise the drawing. Consider where the line will guide the ball before starting the attempt.

pages.title: Hook Master Mafia City
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description:
Hook Master Mafia City uses grappling and swinging to turn an escape through the city into a movement puzzle. Catch walls and buildings with the hook, move between attachment points and use your swings to get away from the enemies hunting you.

Click or tap to play. Look at the structures around the route and choose how to use them for the next part of the escape. The two movement styles let you cross the city by hooking onto its scenery and carrying that movement into a swing.

pages.title: Hide & Seek Go And Find
pages.creator: Driving games
pages.description:
Hide & Seek Go And Find gives its characters different things to search for. Play as a parent looking for a child, a child hunting for hidden chocolates, a police officer tracking a thief or a thief gathering valuables. Choosing a role changes the purpose of your search.

Explore the area and look for the person or object assigned to that character. The parents' search centers on finding their child, while the other roles turn the same searching idea into chocolate hunts, police pursuits or treasure collecting. Follow the current objective as you check possible hiding places.

pages.title: Stickman Fight Pro
pages.creator: GamingStudio
pages.description:
Stickman Fight Pro puts a stickman fighter into arena battles against other stickmen and AI opponents. Control the character with the mouse and fight to defeat the enemies, using the available weapons and power-ups to help turn a battle in your favor.

The arenas make movement and reactions part of the combat. Keep track of where the opposing fighters are while choosing when to approach and use the tools at hand. Work through the encounters by combining attacks with movement around the arena.

pages.title: West Frontier Sharpshooter 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description:
West Frontier Sharpshooter 3D casts you as a cowboy taking on armed bandits. Aim at the enemies and shoot to clear the area, choosing the order of your targets while trying to survive their return fire.

Use mouse clicks or taps to play. Some confrontations leave several bandits firing at once, making target selection an important part of the shooting. Examine the enemies ahead and decide which threat to deal with next as you work through the Western gunfights.

pages.title: Egg Farm
pages.creator: TuuT
pages.description:
Egg Farm puts a fox beneath falling eggs and asks you to catch the good ones. Move sideways to line up each catch, avoid the bad eggs and watch for special eggs that provide boosts. Character skins give you different appearances for the fox.

On a keyboard, A and D or the Left and Right arrows move the character. On a touch screen, tap the side you want to move toward. Watch what is falling before rushing underneath it: collecting the right eggs matters as much as reaching them in time.

pages.title: Food Match
pages.creator: playmarketing ou
pages.description:
Food Match is a 3D matching puzzle built around finding sets of three objects inside a ball. Search the pile, select one object and find two more of the same kind. Completing a triplet removes that set, with the goal of clearing all the objects from the field.

Tap the pieces to select them and continue looking for matching trios among the remaining shapes. As the pile thins, use the clearer view to locate the partners for your next set.

pages.title: MrEscape Game
pages.creator: GAMES4KING
pages.description:
MrEscape Game is a room-escape puzzle game about finding a way through a series of locked environments. Examine each room with the mouse, work out its clues and solve the puzzles that open the exit.

The rooms present different arrangements to investigate, with keys, doors and interactive puzzles forming part of the escape. Hints are available when you need help. Look again at the room's details when a solution is unclear, then use the clues you have found to work toward the next doorway.

pages.title: Zombie Treasure Adventure
pages.creator: Best Games
pages.description:
Zombie Treasure Adventure sends you through six levels to find keys and open the treasure. Zombies attack along the route, giving you enemies to fight while you search. Defeating a zombie earns a star, while collected coins add points.

Move with the arrow keys and use Z and X for the weapons. The final level brings a boss zombie into the adventure. Balance the search for keys and coins with the need to deal with approaching enemies so you can continue toward the treasure.

pages.title: Space Tanks: Arcade
pages.creator: ales
pages.description:
Space Tanks: Arcade takes tank combat to a series of planets with different enemies and difficulty. Clear hostile forces while collecting health kits, shields and ammunition, then use earned resources to develop the tank. Upgrades affect health, protection and ammo, and additional modules and appearances provide more customization.

Move with WASD or the arrow keys and fire with Space. Touch controls use swipes for movement and taps for shooting. Each planet offers a chance to improve your clearance record, with the supplies collected during a run helping you stay in the fight.

pages.title: Puper Ball
pages.creator: IT-Hype
pages.description:
Puper Ball puts a football between you and opponents ready to block the way to goal. Use the mouse to control it, maneuver around the defenders and make a sharp movement to take your shot. Getting past the opposition is part of setting up a successful finish.

Bonus chests offer rewards, including additional super balls. Watch how the defenders react as you approach, then look for a route that gives you room to send the ball toward the goal.

pages.title: Sheep N Sheep
pages.creator: Albayoo
pages.description:
Sheep N Sheep is a matching puzzle in which selecting three identical objects removes them from the board. Find each trio among the pieces and continue until the arrangement has been cleared. Larger collections make it harder to distinguish the matching objects.

Tap the pieces to choose them and use the available props when you need assistance. Daily challenges provide one set of puzzles, while classic level mode offers another way to play. Study the remaining objects before selecting the next group so you know where its three matches are.

pages.title: Pull'em All
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description:
Pull'em All turns pulling objects free into a test of your character's strength. Click and hold to pull, watching how long you keep up the effort because prolonged pulling can strain the character. The objective is to get the object out without overdoing the attempt.

Upgrades increase the character's power and help with the objects in later levels. Judge the balance between making progress and sustaining the pull, then use improvements to take on the next challenge.

pages.title: 18 Wheeler Truck Parking 2
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description:
18 Wheeler Truck Parking 2 asks you to maneuver a large truck into difficult parking spaces. Drive through traffic and tight approaches, then line the vehicle up with the designated spot while avoiding damage.

Use WASD or the arrow keys to drive, and Space to brake. The levels place parking challenges in different driving situations, making your approach to the space as important as the final turn into it. Leave room for the truck as you steer around traffic and nearby obstacles.

pages.title: Headphone Rush
pages.creator: Bermuda Games
pages.description:
Headphone Rush sends a pair of headphones along an upgrade course. Use the mouse to guide them through gates that improve the headphones, developing them toward a premium version as you advance.

Look at the gates ahead and steer toward the upgrades you want to reach. The course makes the changing headphones the center of its progression, with your route determining which gates they pass through.

pages.title: Fruits Master Match 3
pages.creator: Pidomtech
pages.description:
Fruits Master Match 3 asks you to collect the required fruits before time runs out. Press an item, trace a chain through adjacent pieces of the same kind and release to remove the selection. A chain needs at least three fruits, and it can connect horizontally, vertically or diagonally.

Longer chains offer bonuses, with selections of more than seven items adding time. Watch the current fruit targets as you search the board so that your matches contribute to the level's goal. Missing the collection target within the time allowance ends the attempt.

pages.title: Farm Pic Tetriz
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description:
Farm Pic Tetriz is a picture-building puzzle played by dropping image fragments into place. Select a piece, move it over the position where it belongs and release it to help reconstruct the complete farm picture.

There are eight levels to finish. Use the mouse or touchpad to position the fragments, comparing their details with the image you are assembling. Work through the remaining gaps until the pieces form the finished scene.

pages.title: Bloxy Block Parkour
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description:
Bloxy Block Parkour is a platform-jumping challenge with a series of obstacle courses. Move through each level, judging the distance between blocks and timing jumps to stay on the route. New platform arrangements change how you need to approach the next section.

Use WASD or the arrow keys for movement. Space or the right mouse button makes the character jump, while touch-screen buttons provide mobile controls. Check the next landing area before leaving your current platform so that you have a clear destination for the jump.

pages.title: High Pizza
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: High Pizza asks you to get pizzas to waiting guests. Slide to move the chef, avoiding obstacles and spoiled pizzas along the way. Watch the route ahead so you can steer clear of hazards while working toward serving the customers.

pages.title: Round 6: The Game
pages.creator: Firstpixel
pages.description:
Round 6: The Game presents seven challenges inspired by Squid Game. Events range from Honeycomb and Marble to Red Light, Green Light. Others include The Big Fight, Glass Tower and Rope Tower, followed by a final Squid Game round. Work through the different tasks to complete the sequence.

Use a mouse or touch screen to play. During fighting or running sections on a computer, M provides a boost. Each round changes the challenge, so pay attention to the task in front of you as you move from one event to the next.

pages.title: Save The Monster
pages.creator: kidsgamesplay
pages.description:
Save The Monster puts a coin-collecting monster on a board threatened by rockets. Slide to move between spaces, picking a route that reaches coins while keeping away from the incoming danger. The goal is to keep the monster alive and collecting for as long as you can.

Every ten coins makes the monster drop a bomb that can destroy some rockets. Use the board's available spaces to plan the next move, watching both the coin locations and the threats around them.

pages.title: Happy Village Toddlers & Kids Educational Games
pages.creator: Digi Smile limited
pages.description:
Happy Village Toddlers & Kids Educational Games brings together activities built around letters, numbers and shapes. Choose a task from the village's menus and use the mouse or touch screen to interact with its pictures and puzzles.

Activities include tracing letters and numbers, matching shapes and playing memory games with uppercase and lowercase letters. The collection moves between recognizing symbols, finding matching items and drawing along a pattern. Pick another activity when you want to switch from alphabet practice to the number and shape tasks.

pages.title: Neon Guitar
pages.creator: JM Neto Game Dev
pages.description:
Neon Guitar is a rhythm game about hitting falling notes to build your score. Watch the notes travel down the neon display and activate the corresponding controls as they arrive, aiming to beat your previous high score.

Keyboard controls use A, S, K and L. You can also play with the mouse, use LT, LB, RB and RT on a gamepad, or tap the on-screen buttons on mobile. Keep your attention on the next notes so you are ready to press the matching control.

pages.title: Brainstorm
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description:
Brainstorm presents a collection of tricky puzzles that ask you to reconsider the obvious answer. Examine each problem and use the mouse to work out its solution, drawing on the clues and logic of the current puzzle.

The questions are built around brain teasers and unexpected answers. If your first interpretation does not solve one, look again at what it is asking and consider another approach before making the next attempt.

pages.title: Golden Scarabeaus
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description:
Golden Scarabeaus is a puzzle game about using square characters to collect every golden beetle in a level. Clicking a character activates its particular ability: some roll, others jump or float, and their different reactions to the scenery create ways around obstacles.

Switches, levers and movable blocks are part of arranging a safe route. Lasers can attract or repel the characters, and some characters can break blocks. Work out the order of your clicks so that each ability helps reach a scarab without sending a character into a hazard.

pages.title: Brain Dunk
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description:
Brain Dunk turns scoring a basket into a drawing puzzle. Drag with a mouse or finger to create a line, then click or tap the ball to release it into the arrangement. Your drawing needs to guide it past the obstacles and into the basket.

The game contains thirty-six levels with different layouts to solve. Look at the ball's starting position, the basket and the hazards between them before drawing. A useful line gives the ball a route through the level when you activate it.

pages.title: Jewelry Contesting
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description:
Jewelry Contesting is a matching challenge with jewelry that changes as it approaches. Watch the incoming piece's shape and color, then use the mouse to make the fixed piece match it. A mismatch ends the game.

Keep checking the approaching jewelry rather than relying on its earlier appearance, since it can change while moving. Your next choice needs to suit the piece that is about to arrive.

pages.title: Monster Clicker
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description:
Monster Clicker is an incremental game about tapping monsters to wear down their health. Defeat the current creature to produce coins and bring in the next monster, then put your earnings toward stronger attacks.

The upgrade system develops your damage and includes automatic tapping. Keep attacking while working toward the next improvement, using the monster's health display to see the effect of your current damage. The loop connects defeating creatures, collecting their coins and purchasing upgrades for the encounters ahead.

pages.title: Drift Racing
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description:
Drift Racing asks you to keep a car moving around an endless track. Tap to control the car and time its drifts through the bends, trying to cover more distance on each attempt.

Watch the approaching turn before acting so that the car follows the track as it changes direction. The course keeps going, making sustained control through successive corners the focus of the run.

pages.title: Chaki Jet
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description:
Chaki Jet gives Chaki a jetpack and sends him flying past obstacles. Use the mouse to control the flight and keep him clear of the objects along his route, aiming to travel as far as possible.

Watch the space ahead before adjusting his position. The challenge is keeping Chaki in flight while finding a clear way past the next obstacle, then carrying that control into the stretch beyond it.

pages.title: Special Motorbike Day Match 3
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description:
Special Motorbike Day Match 3 is a matching puzzle about arranging same-colored blocks into lines of at least three. Make combinations to increase your score while watching the gauge on the left side of the board. Letting that gauge fall too low ends the game.

Use the mouse or touch screen to play. Keep looking for the next line you can complete so that you can continue scoring while managing the pressure from the gauge.

pages.title: Car Eats Car: Sea Adventure
pages.creator: SMOKOKO LTD
pages.description:
Car Eats Car: Sea Adventure combines driving, combat and car upgrades with a mission to free imprisoned cars. Drive past rivals, escape pursuing police and take on bosses while developing a vehicle capable of surviving the chase. The incubator also lets you create cars.

Use W and S to accelerate and brake, with A and D adjusting balance; the arrow keys provide another driving option. Space drops bombs and X activates turbo. Match your driving to the terrain while using the car's combat tools against the enemies sharing the route.

pages.title: Mermaid Cinema Flirting
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description:
Mermaid Cinema Flirting follows a princess and her boyfriend on a movie date. Tap through their time together at the cinema as they share popcorn, chat and kiss after spending time apart.

You also choose a look for each character, adding outfit decisions to the romantic outing. Work through the date's interactions and put together the couple's appearance as their evening continues.

pages.title: Fresh Fruit Mahjong Connection
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description:
Fresh Fruit Mahjong Connection is a tile-pairing puzzle about clearing fruit pictures from the board. Click two matching tiles that can be joined through an open route. Removing a pair leaves space that can make further connections possible.

Check both the fruit picture and the path between the tiles before selecting a pair. Work through the available matches until the board is empty, using the gaps left by earlier removals to reach more distant partners.

pages.title: PGA3 Survival
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description:
PGA3 Survival is a pixel-style shooter with campaign missions and multiplayer modes. Take on armed opponents across maps with different difficulty settings, including a jungle environment, and work through the campaign's combat challenges.

WASD moves the character, Space jumps and Shift runs. Use the mouse to look around, aim, shoot and change weapons, with Tab opening the menu. Multiplayer includes a chat function: Enter opens the message field and sends the message when pressed again. Keep track of the surrounding enemies as you move through each encounter.

pages.title: Tunnel Racer
pages.creator: Parrot Games
pages.description:
Tunnel Racer puts a car inside a curving tunnel filled with obstacles. Use the mouse to guide the run, finding a clear passage through the shapes ahead as you work toward the end of the level.

The changing tunnel and obstacle positions make looking ahead part of keeping the car safe. Reach the level's finish to continue, then adjust to the next stretch of tunnel and its hazards.

pages.title: Lizard Lady vs The Cats
pages.creator: The Voices Games
pages.description:
Lizard Lady vs The Cats follows a masked vigilante fighting a notorious cat gang. Defeat every enemy in the current level to open its exit door, using the lock-on system to keep a target in your sights during combat.

On a keyboard and mouse, the right mouse button locks on, Left Shift dodges and Space jumps. Movement and dodging help you reposition while fighting the remaining enemies. Check for opponents still active before heading for the door, since clearing the level's enemies is what opens the way onward.

pages.title: Ariel New Year New Hairstyles
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description:
Ariel New Year New Hairstyles is a hair-styling game about giving Ariel a different look for the New Year. Work on a braided hairstyle and choose accessories to finish the design.

Click with the mouse or tap on a touch screen to make your selections. Compare the styling choices as you build the braid's appearance, then add the accessories you want Ariel to wear with her new hairstyle.

pages.title: Classic Jeep Parking
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description:
Classic Jeep Parking puts a 4x4 through parking courses with corners, obstacles and marked boundaries. Drive toward the parking space and maneuver the jeep into position, leaving room to get around the objects bordering the route.

WASD controls the vehicle and Space applies the brake. Judge your approach before turning into the parking area so that the jeep can line up with the space. The challenge is controlling the vehicle through the course and completing the park accurately.

pages.title: Killer.io
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description:
Killer.io is a Halloween-party game in which you play the killer. Eliminate partygoers, hide the bodies and try to continue without being caught. The aim is to achieve as many eliminations as possible during the attempt.

Move around the party with the arrow keys or touch controls. Keep the game's concealment objective in mind as you work through the crowd and try to improve your result.

pages.title: Fly Car Stunt 3
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description:
Fly Car Stunt 3 takes flying cars onto neon roads with a futuristic setting. Drive and fly through twelve levels, dealing with an increasing number of traps as the courses progress. The cars use fiery wings for their aerial sections.

Player one drives with WASD, activates nitro with T and changes the camera with Y. Player two uses the arrow keys, P for nitro and C for the camera. R restarts the course. Judge the route ahead before committing to a stunt so that you can bring the car through the next section.

pages.title: Block Wood Puzzle
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description:
Block Wood Puzzle asks you to place wooden shapes into the gaps on a board. Drag a block into position and build a complete row to earn points. Completing at least two rows together awards bonus points.

Consider how each shape fits beside the blocks already placed. Filling a row is the immediate scoring goal, while arranging pieces toward several rows at once gives you a chance to earn the larger bonus.

pages.title: SuperCars Puzzle Game
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description:
SuperCars Puzzle Game asks you to rebuild car photographs from separate picture pieces. Drag each fragment toward its correct place on the grid; a correctly positioned piece snaps into position and contributes to completing the image.

The puzzles run against a countdown, so you need to assemble the car before the available time expires. Compare neighboring details and the shapes of the image fragments as you work across the board. Finishing the photograph completes the level and opens the way to the next puzzle.

pages.title: BTS Hero Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description:
BTS Hero Coloring Book gives you hero-themed pictures to color with a choice of brushes. Select a color, choose a brush size and apply it to the drawing, changing tools when you want a different kind of mark.

Use the mouse or tap to play. Smaller brushes suit the details you want to color carefully, while larger sizes let you work across broader areas. Combine the available colors to give the chosen hero picture your own appearance.

pages.title: Kitty Chase
pages.creator: Aningame
pages.description:
Kitty Chase puts a candy-collecting cat in a stage with a dog to avoid. Move and jump with the arrow keys, reaching the sweets while keeping the cat away from its pursuer. Each candy you collect adds to your score.

Watch the dog's position before moving toward another treat. The task is to keep collecting without letting the chase interfere with the next jump or the route toward the candy.

pages.title: Bounce Color Ball
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description:
Bounce Color Ball is a timing game about bouncing a ball between colored walls. Click or tap to keep it moving, making contact with a wall that matches the ball's current color. Hitting the wrong color ends the attempt.

Successful bounces build your score and change the color you need to watch for next. Stars can be collected along the way. Check both the ball and the approaching wall before the next bounce, since a route that matched a moment ago may no longer be safe.

pages.title: Speed Spin Colors Game
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description:
Speed Spin Colors Game puts a colored dot on a set of orbits. Tap the screen to jump from one orbit to another, avoiding the other colored shapes and collecting bonuses as you try to survive.

Moving into the center or straying too far outside the orbit ends the run. Watch how the nearby shapes move before changing rings so that you can reach a clear stretch without crossing into danger. Staying within the available orbital space matters alongside avoiding the obstacles.

pages.title: Galaxy Domination
pages.creator: marcos bart games
pages.description:
Galaxy Domination is a flight-timing game about guiding a ship through rings in space. Click the mouse to control the ship's height, passing through the circles while avoiding meteors and the planet below.

Each successful ring passage adds to your score. Watch the next opening before adjusting the ship's height, keeping enough clearance from both the ring's edges and the nearby hazards. A collision ends the flight.

pages.title: Circle Pool
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description:
Circle Pool is a ball-shooting puzzle played on a circular board. Aim your ball toward the other balls and use collisions to clear the targets. The level tracks the balls available for your attempts, so choose each shot with the remaining targets in mind.

Clear the arrangement to reach the next level, or use Retry to approach the same challenge again. Look at the positions of the target balls before choosing the direction of the next strike.

pages.title: Bob The Robber 5 Temple Adventure
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description:
Bob The Robber 5 Temple Adventure sends Bob into a temple to steal its treasure. Move through the rooms while dealing with guards and mummies, keeping clear of the watching statues so that Bob can continue without being caught.

The Left and Right arrows move Bob, while Up interacts with coins or enemies. The temple's enemies and surveillance make each stretch of the route something to check before advancing. Work toward the treasure while keeping Bob out of the statues' view.

pages.title: Pregnant Princess Golfs
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description:
Pregnant Princess Golfs is a dress-up game about preparing Rapunzel and Anna for a visit to the golf course. The two expectant princesses want a relaxing outing, and your task is to choose outfits for them to wear.

Use the mouse to make the clothing selections. Put together the appearance you want for each princess, coordinating their golf-day looks as they get ready to head to the course.

pages.title: Cute Mommies Pregnant Sauna
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description:
Cute Mommies Pregnant Sauna follows Ellie and her friend through a spa visit. Help Ellie shower and prepare, then choose the coal and essential oils for the sauna scene. The visit ends with outfit choices for Ellie.

Tap through the preparations and select the items requested during each activity. The game moves from getting ready for the sauna to setting up the room and finishing with Ellie's new look, combining character-care interactions with dress-up.

pages.title: Millionaire with Trump
pages.creator: Red Eye Production
pages.description: Millionaire with Trump is a question-and-answer game featuring Trump. Choose him as your candidate, then work through the questions and try to give the correct responses. Read each question carefully before answering, since getting the answers right is the central challenge of the game.

pages.title: Angry Snakes
pages.creator: Red Eye Production
pages.description:
Angry Snakes puts you in an arena where eating helps your snake grow longer. Steer toward food and keep moving around the other snakes as you develop your length. The growing body gives you more to manage while looking for the next feeding opportunity.

Move the mouse to steer, or guide the snake with touch controls. A speed boost provides another movement option. Watch the space ahead and leave room to turn as you navigate between food and the snakes sharing the arena.

pages.title: Fall Fashion 2017 with Princess
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description:
Fall Fashion 2017 with Princess lets you style Princess Jasmine using her autumn wardrobe. Choose dresses, makeup and hairstyles to put together a fall look, comparing the different combinations as you work on her appearance.

The wardrobe provides choices for creating several outfits for Jasmine. Coordinate a dress with the hair and makeup you prefer, then try another combination when you want to give her a different seasonal style.

pages.title: Bunny Powertastic
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description:
Bunny Powertastic is a character-design game about creating your own superhero's appearance. Work through the customization categories to choose features such as skin tone, hair, clothing and accessories, building the look one choice at a time.

Use the mouse to select categories and their options. Try different outfits and details together as you develop the hero, then review the complete design. The activity centers on deciding how your character looks and combining the available pieces into a superhero style.

pages.title: Jewel Curse
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description:
Jewel Curse takes jewel matching into an ancient Egyptian setting. Make groups of at least three jewels to remove them, working toward clearing the colored jewels from the arrangement as your journey continues.

Play with the mouse or touch controls. Look for combinations that contribute to the board's clearing objective, then examine the remaining jewels for the next group you can make.

pages.title: Super Soccer Star 2
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description:
Super Soccer Star 2 turns football scoring into a series of physics puzzles. Send the ball toward the goal while accounting for obstacles that interrupt the route. The aim is to score goals and build the best result you can across thirty levels.

Study the arrangement before taking the next shot. A direct route may be blocked, so consider how the level's obstacles affect the ball's path toward the net. Work through the different layouts to complete the full set of challenges.
